_comment: RS2 Local — single source of truth for paths + pipeline settings. All paths absolute (Windows).
_ctx_note: Real payload = RS2.txt(~5.2k tok) + fed data(~4k tok) + accumulating prior stages. 16384 overflows late stages, so both run at 24576 (fits w/ generation headroom; ~96% GPU, 4% CPU spill). The 16384/100%-GPU figure applied only to the old manual-data flow.
_watchdog_note: orchestrate.py kills a single run_rs2 child (and unloads both models) if it exceeds this many minutes, then marks the name failed + retries it — fail-safe against a hung run pinning the GPU indefinitely. Avg is ~11 min/name; 40 leaves ~3.5x headroom for a slow deep-research name. Override per-run with --ticker-timeout-min.
_regime_note: MRI current_regime.json can be synthetic_sample (future-dated). rs2_data.py only uses its regime probabilities when the file date is within regime_max_age_days of today; otherwise it feeds real macro_state.json and lets the model classify.
_research_note: Deep-research (LDR) runs in research-venv on a CLEAN model (NOT rs2-analyst — its baked RS2 prompt would contaminate LDR's research prompts). Tavily primary w/ quota guard -> SearXNG fallback (local/unlimited). snippets_only=False = read full pages.
_vram_note: rs2-analyst and rs2-research are BOTH ~23GB on a 24GB card, so they can never co-reside. The unload is a VERIFIED barrier (ops.wait_unloaded): after keep_alive:0 it polls /api/ps AND nvidia-smi free VRAM until the release is observed, because ollama's 200 only means the request finished — it tears the llama-server subprocess down asynchronously. The old blind time.sleep(2) lost that race and OOM'd the next load. free_required is the floor the next ~23GB load needs; timeout is a hard failure (ticker aborts + Telegram) rather than loading into a half-freed card.
_stage_ctx_note: Raised 24576 -> 49152 on 2026-08-20. Measured across 921 real requests: median prompt 7,508 tokens, p90 20,182, max 24,851 — ABOVE the old 24,576 window. 26 completions truncated at exactly n_tokens=24575 and published as successes. 49152 loads fully on GPU at Q4 on this box.
